title: Count Subarrays With Bounded Maximum
description: Given a non-empty non-negative array `nums` and a bound `bound`, count contiguous subarrays whose maximum value is at most `bound`. Input: `nums` and `bound`. Output: the number of qualifying subarrays.
hints: Maintain the prefix or window information needed to count candidate ranges.
Check repeated values, extreme bounds, and cases with no valid segment.
